breakdown.description: The prompt substitutes the bending second moment I for the polar moment J in torsion formulas, even though solid circular shaft torsion is governed by J = π d^4/32.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses J = π d^4/32 (the polar moment of inertia) for both the shear stress formula τ_max = Tc/J and the angle of twist formula φ = TL/(JG). There is no mention of using the bending second moment I = π d^4/64, which was the error in the incomplete prompt. This aligns with the ground truth prompt.
